name: Grease

header.Components: V, S, M (a bit of pork rind or butter)

source.attribution: System Reference Document 5.2.1, Wizards of the Coast LLC; CC BY 4.0.

casting.material: a bit of pork rind or butter

authored_intent: 10-foot square is Difficult Terrain for one minute; initial/entry/end-turn DEX save or Prone according to source; no Concentration and no invented flammability.

rules.text: Nonflammable grease covers the ground in a 10- foot square centered on a point within range and turns it into Difficult Terrain for the duration.
When the grease appears, each creature standing in its area must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or have the Prone condition.
A creature that enters the area or ends its turn there must also succeed on that save or fall Prone.
